title: 第25章 舍与得第26章 幻术
slug: 道爷斗法累了西幻炸个鱼怎么了
lines: 众人又前行了片刻，便来到一处堆满了灵石的祭坛前。
只见祭坛上刻着一行大字：身外之物不足惜，有舍才有得。
“看来，这第二关绝外物便是在这里了，列位都将灵石全都取出来吧。”
冯山说道，随后将储物袋中的灵石取出放于祭坛前。
虽然有着先前的行动，这冯山积攒了一些信誉，可此时涉及到了灵石，众修士不是那么容易相信的。
不像冯山这种家族修士出身，大多散修都将自己全身家当带在身上，你说让大家仗义疏财，兄弟们大多会慷慨解囊，掏些灵石出来，可你说让大家把全部财产都交出来，那大家可要考虑考虑了。
“冯兄，这灵石可是我等修士修炼与交易必备的物品，若是全都交出，定会影响我等未来修行啊”
“是啊是啊冯兄，也许这祭坛的意思并非要求我们全部交出，只要交一些份子钱就可以了吧！”
修士们对冯山的称呼，已经从冯道友变为冯兄，亲昵了些许。
“哎呀诸位，先前那破红尘还不能令诸位明悟吗！”
冯山一脸恨铁不成钢的样式说道。
“此处秘境，显然是规则性很强的秘境，灵石没了还能再赚，可若是因为触动了规则，失了性命，便不好了呀。”
这秘境还会有性命危险吗？”
不肖想，定是白琪的发言。
气氛一下子宁静下来。
“冯道友有些言重了，我看这秘境未必如此严苛”
说话的是张寺。
“我自然是愿意相信冯道友的话……”
张寺这一开口，陈昭便知道，接下来要说但是了。
“但是吧……”
你看，果不其然。
“非要舍弃全部灵石，才能保得平安吧”
“紫阳秘境也算是一处历史悠久的秘境了，千年来每次开启，炼气修士都进入众多，若是不交出全部财产便会身陨，那这事应该早就有所流传，至少张某知道的，便有许多未舍弃财产的修士全须全尾的回来。”
“也许如这祭坛上所写的，舍弃财产，便能获得更多，可若是没有更多呢？那岂不是白费了交出的灵石？”
“我想大家肯定不愿意两袖清风的离开这秘境吧！”
“不过，张某也愿意给冯道友这个面子”
张寺话风一转，从储物袋中掏出了两枚中品灵石，摆在了祭坛之上。
按照十分熟悉的换算规则，一枚中品灵石相当于一百枚下品灵石，这一口气掏出两百下品灵石，显然张寺也是大出血了。
“这两枚中品灵石是张某半数以上的灵石储备，也算是回报冯道友赠与辟谷丹之情”
“感谢张道友理解…”
冯山倒是惊讶，没想到第一个站出来交灵石的是张寺。
有了张寺带头，其他的修士也都纷纷把自己灵石拿了出来，或多或少，但大多都是一半的积蓄。
灵石这东西除了用来交易，大多都用来修炼了，炼气期散修保留的积蓄，差的不会太多，大多都是两三百多些下品灵石，拿出一半多来，也就是一两百。
content_en:
After everyone walked forward for a while, they came to an altar filled with spiritual stones.
I saw a line of big characters engraved on the altar: Don't cherish the things outside you, only by giving up can you gain.
"It seems that the second level of foreign objects is here. Everyone, please take out all the spirit stones."
Feng Shan said, then took out the spirit stones from the storage bag and placed them in front of the altar.
Although Feng Shan had accumulated some credibility due to his previous actions, when it came to spiritual stones, the monks were not so easy to believe him.
Unlike Feng Shan, who comes from a family monk, most casual cultivators carry all their belongings with them. If you ask everyone to give up their wealth, most of the brothers will donate generously and take out some spiritual stones. But if you ask everyone to hand over all their property, then everyone should consider it.
"Brother Feng, these spiritual stones are necessary items for us monks to practice and trade. If we hand over all of them, it will definitely affect our future practice."
"Yes, yes, Brother Feng, maybe the altar does not require us to hand over all of it, but just pay some of the money!"
The monks' name for Feng Shan has changed from Daoist Feng to Brother Feng, which is a bit more intimate.
"Oh everyone, didn't the breaking of the world of mortals earlier make you realize it clearly!"
Feng Shan said with a look of hatred that iron cannot become steel.
"This secret realm is obviously a secret realm with strong rules. You can still earn spiritual stones if you lose them. But if you lose your life because the rules are violated, it will be bad."
"Ah!
Is life still in danger in this secret realm? "
Unexpectedly, it must be Bai Qi's speech.
The atmosphere suddenly became quiet.
"Fellow Daoist Feng is a little harsh. I think this secret realm may not be so harsh."
It was Zhang Si who spoke.
"Of course I am willing to believe what Fellow Daoist Feng says..."
As soon as Zhang Si opened his mouth, Chen Zhao knew that he was going to say no.
"But..."
You see, it's true.
"You have to give up all the spiritual stones to stay safe."
"The Ziyang Secret Realm can be regarded as a secret realm with a long history. Every time it is opened for thousands of years, many Qi Refining monks have entered. If they would die if they did not hand over all their property, then this matter should have been spread a long time ago. At least Zhang knows that many monks who have not given up their property must come back in full."
"Maybe as it is written on this altar, if you give up your property, you can get more, but what if there is no more? Wouldn't it be that the spiritual stones handed over were in vain?"
"I think everyone is not willing to leave this secret realm with nothing but a breeze!"
"However, Zhang is also willing to give fellow Daoist Feng this face."
Zhang Si changed his mind and took out two middle-grade spiritual stones from his storage bag and placed them on the altar.
According to the very familiar conversion rules, one medium-grade spiritual stone is equivalent to one hundred low-grade spiritual stones. Taking out two hundred low-grade spiritual stones in one breath, Zhang Si was obviously bleeding profusely.
"These two middle-grade spiritual stones are more than half of Zhang's spiritual stone reserves. They can also be regarded as repaying fellow Daoist Feng for giving Bigu Pill."
"Thank you Daoyou Zhang for your understanding..."
Feng Shan was surprised. He didn't expect that the first person to stand up and hand over the spirit stone would be Zhang Si.
With Zhang Si taking the lead, other monks also took out their spiritual stones, more or less, but most of them were half of their savings.
In addition to being used for trading, most of the spiritual stones are used for cultivation. The savings kept by casual cultivators during the Qi refining period are not too different. Most of them are more than two to three hundred low-grade spiritual stones. Take out more than half, which is one or two hundred.
